outcome: Robots are anonymous: heterogeneity is declared as exact role compositions, and the Controller cannot read N, the arena size or the run length
owner_impact: Fourth release of #577, following your decisions D-021 and D-022. Initialization declares roles, for example role("informed", fraction=config.RHO, informed=1.0) and role("uninformed", rest=True, informed=0.0). Counts are exact in every run: a fraction gives round(fraction x N), and one role takes the rest. Members are dealt to the robots at random from a separate random stream, so placement draws are unchanged; alternatively each member is placed explicitly with place(..., role="leader"). The compiler checks the composition and reports the counts, in the Lab's setup message and to GPT. set_agent_state is retired: stored revisions that used it no longer compile. A Controller can no longer read N, ARENA_SIZE or EXPERIMENT_DURATION; no production Controller used them. Your three Experiments that used set_agent_state (Constant Bearing Flocking, its candidate showcase, and Firat's informed aggregation) are migrated to roles as new revisions. Constant Bearing Flocking now has exactly 80 informed robots instead of a random number around 80. The student Experiment 'Swarm vs Swarm - Case 1' (Sergio Gutierrez) is not changed, because supervision is read-only; a migrated source is ready for him. Test now: yes. Open Constant Bearing Flocking and run it; the setup message should read 'Roles: informed 80, uninformed 120'.
